name: ALPHA DESIGN ERP Cloud v4.5.67 DEEP QA AUTOHEAL RELEASE
releaseEvidencePolicy: Production use still requires real Supabase parity, parallel reconciliation with signed company source data, statutory/tax schema validation, backup/restore and dual sign-off.
fixes: Corrects the automatic corporate-income-tax rate boundary so annual revenue exactly equal to VND 50 billion remains in the 17% band; only revenue above VND 50 billion falls to the standard rate.
Corrects the structural browser QA harness so dashboard KPI size rules inspect only the core dashboard KPI grid and no longer create false positives from compact operational KPI cards.
Adds a deterministic fail-closed auto-heal program that only applies allowlisted source patches, rebuilds public/schema artifacts, removes transient cache files and reruns regression gates.
Adds a master Vietnamese QA program and detailed CSV matrix covering formulas, accounting, tax, finance, workflows, security, browser behavior, performance, recovery and production UAT.
Adds migration 075 to bind statutory certification and the active Cloud release to v4.5.67 without weakening the existing TT99 publication block or external production gates.
Adds a dedicated Thùng rác subsystem that retains deleted business records for 30 days instead of destroying them immediately.
Restores records to their original collection, module, subview and array position while rejecting identifier conflicts without overwriting live data.
Supports individual and bulk permanent purge, automatic hourly/startup expiry cleanup, deferred Cloud-file deletion and local IndexedDB file recovery.
Preserves all accounting, tax, posted-journal, linked-record and project-archive deletion guards before a record may enter the recycle bin.
Restricts recycle-bin visibility, restore and permanent purge to security administrators with MFA AAL2 in Cloud environments.
Adds migration 074 with payload validation, source-record matching, protected RLS visibility, hard purge finalization and optional pg_cron cleanup after 30 days.
Replaces AR, EAC, CPI and SPI column abbreviations with complete Vietnamese names in the operational-control project table.
Uses complete Vietnamese terminology across control subtitles, cards, calculation explanations, filters, warnings and confidence labels.
Reallocates the twelve control-table columns so long Vietnamese headers wrap legibly without clipping the values below them.
Adds migration 073 to bind Cloud statutory certification to release 4.5.65 without changing accounting or tax formulas.
Eliminates the visible one-second first-row flash by restoring table scroll synchronously before the browser's first paint.
Removes the two-animation-frame viewport delay introduced in v4.5.63 while retaining vertical, horizontal, row-anchor and page-position continuity.
Adds migration 072 to bind Cloud statutory certification to release 4.5.64 without changing accounting or tax formulas.
Preserves the vertical position of every shared table after approve, reject, post, lock, delete, edit-save and other in-view rerenders.
Preserves horizontal table position and the first visible record anchor after a rerender, including the approval table shown in the reported defect.
Resets table position intentionally when the user navigates to another view, switches a logical subtab, changes the reporting period or applies a different global filter.
Adds migration 071 to bind Cloud statutory certification to release 4.5.63 while preserving all v4.5.62 accounting and tax hardening.
Stops trusting the manual Input-invoice Paid flag as VAT evidence; deduction now requires a linked Paid Expense, an exact Posted bank-112 journal and matching vendor identity.
Calculates input-VAT deduction proportionally for verified partial payments and excludes future-dated, cash-111, wrong-vendor, unposted or over-limit evidence.
Makes TK242 current versus long-term classification identical in the financial-position engine and B01 statutory report, with unspecified TK242 classified as long-term.
Adds migration 070 to enforce linked Input-invoice payment evidence, immutability, deletion safety, overpayment caps and release 4.5.62 Cloud certification binding on the server.
Corrects the 2026 CIT revenue boundary so exactly VND 50 billion uses the standard 20% rate while the 17% band ends below VND 50 billion.
Applies the 2026 resident salary PIT deductions and five-bracket schedule from 1 January 2026 and migrates the legacy 1 July effective date.
Excludes input VAT from deduction when purchases at the VND 5 million threshold lack qualifying non-cash payment evidence, including same-supplier same-day aggregation.
Adds a critical VAT deduction-evidence integrity control and blocks invalid deductible input invoices at entry time.
Blocks every TT99 statutory export because the prior implementation only relabeled TT133 rows and was not validated against Appendix IV of Circular 99/2025/TT-BTC.
Rebinds TT133 Cloud certification to release 4.5.62 and migration 070 instead of accepting an older release certificate.
Replaces the pale department-count outline with a proportional multicolor donut ring whose segments match the department list, including accessible summary text and dark-mode-safe center contrast.
Adds the TT132 statutory financial statement screen instead of the previous locked warning.
Implements B01-DNSN, B02-DNSN, F01-DNSN and F02-DNSN calculation, validation, display and export flows.
Supports native TT132 accounts 9111/9112 and 33131/33134/33138 while safely collapsing existing TT133-compatible balances into TT132 forms.
Adds the TT132 baseline statutory template to public builds and the offline service-worker shell.
Extends the fail-closed export gate so TT132 packages require balanced B01/F01, valid B02 arithmetic and reconciled F02 tax obligations.
Blocks full ZIP packages until the active TT133/TT99 statutory report passes the same release gate as single-report exports.
Blocks draft or unbalanced statutory JSON and direct print/PDF paths instead of allowing them to bypass release controls.
Revalidates TT133 Cloud certification hashes before direct print and full-package generation.
Propagates TT99 to the cash-flow sheet and account-master title so TT99 packages do not contain TT133 form labels.
Adds executable browser validation for XLSX, PDF print view, CSV, XML, DOCX, JSON and full ZIP packages.
Records the completed exact-package structural and 18-step browser run truthfully instead of retaining contradictory incomplete flags.
Uses the current release version for responsive table-grid metadata.
Prefers Playwright's headless shell when available so browser QA remains runnable in restricted CI containers.
Removes three superseded browser scripts whose selectors represented layouts intentionally replaced by later releases.
Removed generated browser screenshots and result folders from releases v4.5.56-v4.5.58; retained deterministic golden evidence and executable QA scripts.
Removed superseded release reports, defect-closure files and external-gate snapshots from v4.5.56-v4.5.58.
Rebuilt the public deployment directory from the allowlist and regenerated the SHA-256 manifest.
Preserves the v4.5.58 local-data storage namespace because v4.5.66 migrates the browser payload in place.
Keeps the TT99 report card selected after clicking instead of silently reverting to TT133.
Shows a clear accounting-regime mismatch notice while still allowing TT99 preview.
Corrects the statutory release gate so TT99 is validated against TT99 rather than the hard-coded TT133 regime.
Separates TT99 B09 notes from TT133 Cloud notes and enables the full local TT99 B09 edit workflow.
Allows TT99 XLSX export after the configured regime and local statutory integrity checks pass.
Includes the TT99 baseline template in the offline service-worker shell and excludes the inactive statutory regime from full ZIP packages.
Restores full VND values in the dashboard table by reallocating desktop column widths without abbreviating financial data.
Prevents payroll chart overflow at desktop width while preserving the complete donut legend.
Keeps intentionally wide annual-benefit and payroll tables in accessible horizontal scroll regions instead of clipping their columns.
Repairs offline and XSS browser audits by loading all mandatory runtime modules and waiting deterministically for application readiness.
Updates the production-invariant audit to verify the current confirmation-backed soft-archive workflow and preservation of linked contracts.
Corrects the browser release runner so a failed summary cannot double-count an already-recorded failed step.
Moves the dashboard data-source explanation out of the KPI grid and restores the compact three-card operating context row.
Repairs local save failures by cleaning obsolete ALPHA ERP storage keys and retrying the current-version write.
Makes direct timesheet approval persist and refresh all Draft payroll periods.
Completes payroll and annual-benefit workflow buttons from calculation through review, approval, lock and CSV export.
Allows project edits to persist and soft-archives referenced projects instead of rejecting deletion or destroying transaction history.
Supports integrated TT133 and TT99 financial statement sets and propagates the selected accounting regime to policy, account metadata, accounting view, statutory templates and export center.
Compacts operational, planning and financial KPI cards into a single desktop row.
Removes the duplicate employee-by-department chart and keeps the detailed department structure.
Removes unnecessary horizontal scrollbars from 12-month charts and switches money axes automatically between million and billion VND.
Rearranges tax analysis charts horizontally and expands chart/table viewports requested in the annotated UI review.

migrationAudit: Migrations 001-075 ordered, consolidated and checksum verified; migration 075 binds v4.5.67 certification only.

fixed: The structural browser harness applied dashboard KPI size thresholds to compact operational KPI rows and produced two false positives.
Automatic CIT incorrectly assigned the standard 20% rate to annual revenue exactly equal to VND 50 billion instead of the inclusive 17% band.
Operational-control headers and explanations exposed AR, EAC, CPI and SPI abbreviations instead of complete Vietnamese names.
The v4.5.63 delayed restore briefly painted row 1 before returning to the user's current table row.
Shared table rerenders discarded vertical and horizontal scroll state after approve, reject and other row mutations.
Superseded QA screenshots and historical release snapshots inflated the package by roughly 26 MB.
The release folder mixed current runtime assets with three generations of generated browser evidence.
Dashboard money columns clipped complete VND values at 1280px.
The payroll donut card could force horizontal body overflow at desktop widths.
An intentionally wide annual-benefit table lost its accessible horizontal scroll contract.
Offline and XSS audits crashed before application initialization because their runtime module lists were stale.
The production-invariant audit still expected a legacy hard-delete rejection instead of confirmation-backed soft archive.
The browser release runner could report one summary failure twice.
Dashboard source note broke the KPI layout.
Timesheet approval, project save and workflow buttons could fail when obsolete localStorage payloads consumed browser quota.
Payroll and annual-benefit workflow controls did not complete their full state transitions in the reviewed build.
Referenced projects could not be managed safely through the delete action.
TT99 was not a fully selectable integrated BCTC set alongside TT133.
Several KPI groups wrapped to a second line and several 12-month charts showed avoidable horizontal scrollbars.
Money charts had fixed or contradictory unit labels instead of a shared adaptive million/billion scale.
The employee overview contained overlapping department summaries.
Tax analysis charts and some table/chart viewports were too cramped.
Full ZIP export could bypass the active statutory release gate.
Statutory JSON and direct print paths did not consistently share the certified release gate.
TT99 full packages could retain TT133 labels in cash-flow and account-master sheets.
Release metadata contradicted completed browser evidence and table-grid metadata remained pinned to v4.5.50.
